checks.name: Edition artifacts
checks.description: report.md and data.json exist for this edition

checks.name: Numeric-claim coverage
checks.description: every numeric claim in the report carries a resolvable marker on its line

checks.name: Marker resolution
checks.description: every cited marker resolves — pinned snapshot on disk, active assumption, computed series, config file, active waiver

checks.name: Estimation language
checks.description: estimation words (estimated / likely / modeled / approximately …) cite a stated assumption record

checks.name: Pin freshness
checks.description: every pinned snapshot is within its dataset's max_age_days, or a cited waiver is active

checks.name: Series hygiene
checks.description: every data.json series declares a valid evidence class and its provenance

checks.name: Derivation chain
checks.description: every derived series declares HOW it was derived — a method and its inputs (src/derived/config markers), so the data chain is walkable

checks.name: Plan currency
checks.description: the question has an analysis plan and this edition was computed under its current version — a drifted or missing plan is called out, and intent-honoring is verified by an agent intent-check
